book.acquisitionNote: Independent Covenant translation of the distinct prayer in Column B only. Column A overlaps Psalm 154 and is intentionally not duplicated; Column C is too fragmentary for continuous reader text. The wording 'concerning Jonathan' preserves the interpretive ambiguity of ליהונתן.
